owner_sentence: ผ้าที่พับและวางไว้ในตู้ built in ยังเป็นโมเดลปั้นเอง / ของที่วางในตู้ก็วางไม่เป็นธรรมชาติ

evidence.what: Sage cloth on the top shelf: visible portion is a smooth featureless crumpled lobe - no fold rolls, no edge thickness, no layer lines - shoved to the back-left of the shelf so the fascia occludes most of it. Reads as a dropped crumple, not folded storage.

Dark-sage folded cloth: believable fold roll and wrinkle irregularity (cloth-read passes), but it is jammed against the bay's left partition with the roll riding the shelf's front lip, the lone item in the bay - position reads placed-by-collision, not stored.

Whole shelf column: three lone cloths across roughly seven compartments, every other bay bare (arrow on the empty bay below the sage cloth). This is the isolated-single-item-on-empty-shelf staging pattern, not natural storage.

note: Split verdict on the cloth half: the mint striped garment (lower-left shelf, ~[590,995]-[770,1090]) is genuinely believable folded satin - layered folds, rolled edges, collar and a label tag, flat stable contact - and the dark-sage fold also reads as real cloth. No identical folded-stack asset is visibly repeated (crumple vs flat fold vs striped garment; the two sage items share color but not silhouette or folds). The failure is (1) the top-shelf item, whose visible pixels show an unfolded featureless crumple hidden behind the fascia, and (2) placement naturalness overall: every occupied shelf holds exactly one isolated cloth and most bays are empty. Hand-built-vs-purchased provenance is not pixel-decidable; judged only on what the pixels show. Sub-verdicts: A folded-cloth read PARTIAL (2 of 3 believable), B duplication NONE VISIBLE, C placement NOT NATURAL.
